notes.title: Roll7 announces NEW Multiplayer Action Title – Laser League!
notes.content:
[b]WE MADE A NEW THING![/b] A multiplayer thing with more lasers and neon lights than you can shake a stick at.
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ZTxNX2r7I9I
[h1]WHAT IS LASER LEAGUE?![/h1]

[i]In Laser League, the exhilarating, high-octane contact sport of 2150, players battle against the opposition for control of nodes that bathe the arena in deadly light. Evading rival colored beams, teams attempt to fry their opponents with speed, strength and strategy. Special offensive and defensive abilities, as well as game-changing power-ups on the arena floor, provide an edge at the crucial moment. Like all great sports, it is accessible and immediately understandable, but rewards dedication with deceptively complex strategic possibilities.[/i]

Interested? We hope so, as we’re going to need your help in the [b]Laser League BETA![/b]

At [b]Roll7[/b] we are extremely greatful for the love and support our fans have shown us over the years from [b]OlliOlli, OlliOlli2: Welcome to Olliwood and NOT A HERO[/b] - and we hope you’ll join the fight with us on our next venture.

What are you waiting for?! [b]ENLIST FOR THE LASER LEAGUE BETA NOW:[/b]

www.laserleaguegame.com

Join the Forums and add to your wishlist here:

http://store.steampowered.com/app/570460/Laser_League/

Your feedback will be crucial to sculpting and cultivating the sport of the future and we’d love you along for the journey…

Thank you!

notes.title: NOT A HERO major update, performance improvements, windowed mode, DS4 official support, 4 new languages and Achievements!
notes.content:
As promised, our port of NOT A HERO on Windows is now ready for all you Bunnylord supporters to pick up in this latest update!

* Users who had framerate issues will find the new version much more stable, making those explosions even more glorious!
* The game now has a Windowed mode! Press Alt + Return to toggle between Windowed and Full-screen.
* DualShock 4 controllers now work properly in both the menus and in-game.
* NOT A HERO now comes in 4 new amazing flavours (French, German, Italian and Spanish) you can switch to these in NOT A HERO > Properties > Languages!

and the big one...

* 12 Steam Achievements for you all to pick throughout the game! Already played the game but just want these shiny new Achievements? No worries, we will be posting a small guide soon as to how you can get them all in record time!

v1.0 will still be available for all to play, this can be run by selecting "Run in safe mode (legacy)" on the version selector that appears when hitting "Play" within Steam.

Thanks for your continued support!

roll7

notes.title: Incoming framerate improvements!
notes.content:
Hey anti-heroes and heroines! 
Exciting news from roll7 HQ, we have taken the time to port NOT A HERO over to a new engine that makes the game run better than ever before, delivering a version with increased framerate stability! This will be issued in the form of an update here on Steam, as well as for DRM free versions on the GoG and Humble stores. 
We don’t have a release date for this yet, but rest assured, the new version is in its final stages and will be with you all soon.

Thanks for all your patience and support!

Roll7

notes.title: PRE-ORDER NOT A HERO, GET OLLIOLLI FOR FREE!
notes.content:
Election day draws near and BunnyLord is not opposed to bribing you for your support! When you pre-order Not A Hero or Not A Hero: Global MegaLord Edition you will receive the award-winning skateboarding masterpiece OlliOlli absolutely free - a $6,000 value! And if you already own it - which you should - you'll be able to gift it to a friend or loved one. 

Simply pre-order Not A Hero before the May 7th release date and you'll automatically receive OlliOlli. And you'll also implicitly show support for BunnyLord. That's the deal.

http://store.steampowered.com/app/274250/
